import redis
src=redis.Redis(host='127.0.0.1',port=6379)
dst=redis.Redis(host='127.0.0.1',port=6380)
count=0; streams=0; groups=0
for db in range(16):
 a=redis.Redis(port=6379,db=db); b=redis.Redis(port=6380,db=db)
 ka=set(a.scan_iter(count=500)); kb=set(b.scan_iter(count=500))
 assert ka==kb, (db,'keys',len(ka),len(kb),list(ka-kb)[:3],list(kb-ka)[:3])
 for k in ka:
  t=a.type(k); assert t==b.type(k),(db,k,'type')
  va=a.pexpiretime(k); vb=b.pexpiretime(k)
  assert va==vb,(db,k,'expire timestamp',va,vb)
  if t==b'string': x=a.get(k);y=b.get(k)
  elif t==b'hash': x=a.hgetall(k);y=b.hgetall(k)
  elif t==b'list': x=a.lrange(k,0,-1);y=b.lrange(k,0,-1)
  elif t==b'set': x=a.smembers(k);y=b.smembers(k)
  elif t==b'zset': x=a.zrange(k,0,-1,withscores=True);y=b.zrange(k,0,-1,withscores=True)
  elif t==b'stream':
   streams+=1; x=a.xrange(k);y=b.xrange(k)
   assert a.xinfo_stream(k)==b.xinfo_stream(k),(db,k,'stream info')
   ga=a.xinfo_groups(k);gb=b.xinfo_groups(k)
   assert ga==gb,(db,k,'groups',ga,gb)
   groups+=len(ga)
   for g in ga:
    name=g['name']
    assert a.xinfo_consumers(k,name)==b.xinfo_consumers(k,name),(db,k,name,'consumers')
    assert a.xpending(k,name)==b.xpending(k,name),(db,k,name,'pending summary')
    assert a.xpending_range(k,name,'-','+',100000)==b.xpending_range(k,name,'-','+',100000),(db,k,name,'pending detail')
  else: raise Exception(('unsupported type',t,k))
  assert x==y,(db,k,'value')
 count+=len(ka)
 print('db',db,'keys',len(ka)) if ka else None
print('Verified',count,'keys',streams,'streams',groups,'consumer groups; values, types, absolute expiry times, stream metadata and pending entries match')
